text: I've cheated plenty of times in my life, by the way, but I'm a reformed cheater. I've never, I would never do it again. Never again. I don't know, I kind of think everyone deserves a one-time cheat in their relationship or marriage. If a woman cheated before, will she cheat again? And the answer is quite simple. In most cases, yes. Maybe not today, maybe not next week, but the probability of it happening at some point in the future is quite high. And once again, to be fair to the ladies, I do think the similar logic applies to men. But why is that? Why, if she cheated before, she will most probably cheat again? First reason. In the majority of cases, cheating is not just a mistake. It is a decision. So in a way, you can think of the proclivity to cheating as a personality trait. And since it is a personality trait, there is a high chance that if the opportunity presents itself, you will be betrayed again. Second reason. Once that line is crossed, it is easier to cross again. If she knows that she cheated and you forgave her for that, she knows she can get away with it again. Moreover, by doing this, you showed that you don't really have boundaries, principles, or self-respect. And how would she respect you if you don't even respect yourself? She crossed the line and you let her get away with it. Don't be surprised when she crosses it again. Third reason. Past behavior is the best predictor of future behavior, especially in dating. Now you can say, don't people change? What if she realized her mistakes? To that I would answer. Yes, people change, but very rarely. Unfortunately, in most cases, they stay relatively the same. It is up to you to play Russian roulette with your life in hopes that your case is unique. But most of the time, you would lose. There is a saying attributed to the ancient philosopher Omar Khayyam who said, I have seen women who never cheated and I have seen women who cheated many times, but I have never seen a woman who cheated only once. Bottom line, if a woman cheated before, there is a very high chance she will cheat again.
